figures.finding: The only pay floor found for a performer employed in the US Virgin Islands is the territory's minimum wage as the US Department of Labor lists it: USD 10.50 an hour, with premium pay after 8 hours a day, 40 a week and on a 6th or 7th consecutive day.

value.basis: territorial minimum wage, not a screen agreement

figures.applies: US Virgin Islands; all employees covered.

sources.said: Virgin Islands Basic Minimum Rate (per hour): $10.50 Premium Pay After Designated Hours 1 : Daily 8; Weekly – 40; Any hours worked on the 6th or 7th consecutive day of work.

figures.finding: In the 2010 census of the US Virgin Islands, 71.6% of people aged 5 and over spoke only English at home, 17.2% Spanish or Spanish Creole and 8.6% French or French Creole (the 2020 figures were collected but not found); no source names the language of screen work.

value.basis: census language at home, not a statement on film

sources.said: English only 70,864 71.6% … Spanish or Spanish Creole 16,994 17.2% … French or French Creole 8,541 8.6% … Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2010 Census, U.S. Virgin Islands
